label: Contract Review & Analysis
description: Review contracts for risk, regulatory compliance, missing clauses, and commercial balance. Get clause-by-clause findings with negotiation guidance.

guidedInputs.label: Type of contract
guidedInputs.description: The contract type determines which regulatory requirements and standard terms apply.

guidedInputs.label: Your position in the contract
guidedInputs.description: This determines which party's interests to prioritise in the review.

options.label: We are the service provider / vendor
We are reviewing as third-party advisor
We are reviewing as regulator / auditor

guidedInputs.label: What to focus on
guidedInputs.description: Select all relevant focus areas for the review.

guidedInputs.label: Governing law
guidedInputs.description: The governing law determines which legal standards apply.

guidedInputs.label: Specific concerns or questions
guidedInputs.description: Anything you are worried about or want looked at closely.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., We are concerned about the liability cap and exit provisions. Are the SCA requirements correctly addressed?

exampleInput: Review this draft master services agreement between our bank and CloudCore AB, who will host our core customer-data platform. We are the client. The vendor's draft caps total liability at three monthly fees, permits subcontracting without consent, has a 36-month initial term with automatic renewal, and gives the vendor 90 days to remedy any breach before we may terminate. As an EU-regulated credit institution we need DORA ICT third-party requirements and GDPR processor terms addressed. Flag missing clauses, assess the liability and exit provisions clause by clause, and give us a negotiation position for each red flag.

exampleValues.concerns: Liability cap of three monthly fees looks far too low for a platform hosting customer data. No audit or supervisory access rights, no exit-assistance obligation, and the data-processing annex is missing sub-processor notification terms.
